basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old from Manchester, UK, trying to explore different aspects of online communities. Currently working as a junior graphic designer, I enjoy experimenting with digital art in my free time. I'm in a complicated relationship, which sometimes reflects in my online interactions. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings, after work, when I need to unwind. My interests vary widely, from alternative music and fitness to cryptocurrency trends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I developed my graphic design skills through a combination of formal education and online tutorials. I have a keen interest in lifestyle and fitness trends, which I mostly explore through self-teaching and community discussions. Additionally, I dabble in cryptocurrency as a hobby, learning from various subreddits and online resources.
